notes: Mirror of the official skill. These cases check it still works when installed from SkillHub and fits the Hub chain; upstream behaviour itself is not re-specified here.

evals.prompt: 帮我做一个 skill：把客户发来的 BOM Excel 转成我们 MES 的导入模板，列名对不上的要列出来
expectations: asks about intent, triggers and output before writing (Capture Intent)
writes a SKILL.md with name and a description that says when to trigger

evals.prompt: 用 skill-creator 给 ~/work/po-helper 跑一下评测，看装了和没装差多少
evals.setup: skill-creator installed via skillhub into ~/.claude/skills/skill-creator (no hub.yaml, no evals of its own)
expectations: resolves scripts relative to the installed skill-creator folder, not a hardcoded path
sets up with-skill and baseline runs in a workspace next to the target skill

evals.prompt: 把 ~/work/po-helper 打包成 .skill 文件
expectations: reports where the .skill file was written
